integrity: The infinite family is proved analytically. The bundled checker is only a finite exact-arithmetic replay of representative instances and is not presented as an infinite certificate. Novelty is based on targeted literature and database comparison and retains a residual risk of obscure equivalent prior observations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the unrooted top member \(C_d\) on pure bipartite states for \(d\ge 3\). It does not classify all lower raw hierarchy members, does not treat mixed-state extensions, and does not challenge the source's deterministic Nielsen-majorization theorem.
title: Raw top concurrence hierarchy fails average LOCC monotonicity in every dimension \(d\ge 3\)
